responsibility: This module is GCC’s shared OpenMP/OpenACC middle-end and offloading subsystem. It provides the common APIs, selector metadata, builtin/runtime registries, and generic utilities used to recognize directives, clauses, runtime calls, loop forms, and declare-variant context information; then it lowers high-level GIMPLE_OMP/OpenACC constructs into explicit data-sharing, reduction, task, worksharing, target, and structured-control representations, expands those lowered regions into CFG structure, outlined functions, and libgomp/libgoacc runtime call sequences, and manages host/device offloading bookkeeping such as declare target discovery and emitted offload tables. It also contains specialized support for GPU/grid and OpenACC device execution transforms, OpenACC kernels decomposition and worker/broadcast rewriting, plus the IPA machinery for OpenMP declare simd cloning, so the module as a whole covers the compiler’s pragma-based parallelism pipeline from shared semantic support through lowering, device-specific transformation, and final runtime-oriented expansion.
